prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a single exploratory app icon for a personal private photo vault with a dog guardian mascot. NEW DESIGN, distinct from previous rear-view dog concepts. Primary request: FRONT VIEW of a friendly blue-grey cartoon HUSKY whose WAGGING TAIL IS A KEY. One original compact husky sitting facing the viewer, upright triangular ears, broad friendly face, blue-grey coat with classic cream-white husky facial mask, white chest and two little front paws. Calm warm approachable expression, small smile, alert but never fierce, no bared teeth. The husky's tail is attached naturally behind its right hip and curves upward into the open space beside its body. The actual tail forms a recognizable old-fashioned KEY: a thick curved tail shaft rising to a rounded loop bow, with two broad squared key teeth on one side of its lower shaft. Make this read as ONE anatomical dog tail transformed into a key, not a dog holding a separate key, not a key on its collar, and not a key floating beside it. Show the tail's attachment to the body clearly. Two short discreet motion strokes beside the tail suggest wagging. Key-tail should have nearly equal visual importance to the face and remain clear at app icon size. Style: polished simplified cartoon mascot, clean bold vector-like shapes, restrained outlines, mostly flat color with very minimal shading, no fur texture or fine detail. Palette: slate blue grey #748DA6, darker slate #435B75 and warm white #FFF4DE against solid deep plum #241E32. Tail uses blue grey with white tip/accents if needed, never gold hardware. Composition: centered front-facing dog with visible tail to the right, compact rounded silhouette contained within about 78 percent of the canvas, generous margins, one clear focal composition. Opaque edge-to-edge SQUARE background, no baked rounded outer corners, no presentation board, no text or lettering, no logo wordmark, no watermark. No padlock or keyhole anywhere, no rear-view anatomy joke. Do not imitate an existing cartoon husky, Balto film character or existing software mascot. Original character concept only.
